name: guard-the-kill
title: A guard for the kill that throws EINVAL
description: A previous round reproduced a defect: a pre-aborted AbortSignal reaches abort immediately after spawn, child.kill throws EINVAL on Windows for a process that has not started, and the throw escapes asynchronously. The timeout walks the same path. Guard the kill and restore the case that found it, as its test
creator: aixi
